created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the RBAC Group was created.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the RBAC Group. Not uniqueness-enforced.

role_ids.title: Role Ids
role_ids.description: RBAC Role IDs attached to this RBAC Group. Role attachment is managed in the admin settings and is read-only on this API. `null` means role data was temporarily unavailable — retry to distinguish from an empty list.

source_type.title: Source Type
source_type.description: How the RBAC Group was created: `"direct"` for groups created directly (for example, in the organization's admin settings), `"scim"` for groups provisioned by the identity provider.

type.title: Type
type.description:
Object type.

For RBAC Groups, this is always `"rbac_group"`.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the RBAC Group was last updated.
